pins.name: Çemberlitaş Hamamı
pins.description: Masterpiece by Mimar Sinan, 1584. Still heated by traditional wood-burning furnace. Ottoman inscriptions on marble slabs. 440 years of uninterrupted steam therapy.

pins.name: Kılıç Ali Paşa Hamamı
pins.description: Built by Mimar Sinan for Ottoman Navy admiral Kılıç Ali Paşa. Istanbul's 2nd largest dome. Award-winning restoration in 2016. Built to heal sailors — still healing visitors.

pins.name: Hürrem Sultan Hamamı
pins.description: Between Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. Built by Hürrem Sultan, wife of Suleiman the Magnificent. Served as a carpet warehouse for decades — now fully restored to its original glory.

pins.name: Cağaloğlu Hamamı
pins.description: Last grand Ottoman hammam. NYT 1000 Places to See Before You Die. Florence Nightingale, Kate Moss, John Travolta bathed here. Baroque Ottoman architecture.

pins.name: Galatasaray Hamamı
pins.description: Built by Sultan Bayezid II at the request of Dervish Gül Baba. Continuously operating since 1481. Used by Ottoman sultans and grand viziers. Istanbul's most iconic neighborhood hammam.

pins.name: Süleymaniye Hamamı
pins.description: Part of the grand Süleymaniye Mosque complex by Mimar Sinan. 450+ years of operation. Dramatic arches, marble inlay, and domed ceiling filtering soft light.

pins.name: Zeyrek Çinili Hamamı
pins.description: Recently restored 16th-century hammam in the historic Zeyrek neighborhood. At the center of Istanbul's hammam renaissance — a new generation rediscovering ancient ritual.

pins.name: Gedikpaşa Hamamı
pins.description: One of Istanbul's oldest surviving bathhouses, built by architect Mimar Hayrettin. First large bazaar hammam. Horasan mortar domed ceiling, double baths for men and women.

pins.name: Eski Kaplıca Hamamı (Kervansaray)
pins.description: The oldest thermal hammam in Türkiye. Used since Roman times. Byzantine Empress Theodora's beauty secret is said to be hidden here. Built on Byzantine bathhouse ruins. 650+ years of healing.

pins.name: Yeni Kaplıca
pins.description: Commissioned by Grand Vizier Rüstem Pasha to treat Sultan Suleiman's gout and rheumatism. Natural mineral thermal waters. 102-bed hotel in the same complex.

pins.name: Tarihi Saray Hamamı
pins.description: Built by Mihal Bey in 1422. Mentioned in Evliya Çelebi's legendary travel book Seyahatname. One of the oldest surviving Ottomam hammams outside Istanbul.

pins.name: Ali Paşa Hamamı
pins.description: Ottoman-era hammam near the iconic Selimiye Mosque. Double bath structure, classic Ottoman dome. Gateway to Thrace wellness culture.

pins.name: Karacabey Hamamı
pins.description: Operating since 1440 in Altındağ. Türkiye's only hammam known for its exceptional acoustic experience — the sound of water echoes like a natural concert hall. Cash only, authentically local.

pins.name: Yeni Kapı Hamamı
pins.description: One of Antalya's oldest hammams, named after the historic city gate. Inside Kaleiçi old town. Classic Ottoman hammam architecture preserved for 530+ years.

pins.name: Büyük Paşa Hamamı
pins.description: Built by Lala Mustafa Pasha in 1577. One of the finest examples of classical Turkish hammam architecture — square cold room, domed warm room, octagonal göbek taşı. Still actively operating.

pins.name: Meydan Hamamı
pins.description: Trabzon's only double hammam with separate men's and women's sections. Offers revitalizing treatments beyond standard hammam rituals. A Black Sea wellness institution.

pins.name: Kurşunlu Hamamı
pins.description: Built in 1576 — 450 years of continuous service without interruption. Sivas's most enduring wellness institution. Ottoman architectural heritage in the heart of Anatolia.

pins.name: Sultan Hamamı
pins.description: Built by Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent in honor of his mother Ayşe Hafsa Sultan. Houses the largest göbek taşı (marble slab) in the Aegean Region. Double hammam, grand and beautifully preserved.

pins.name: Gülgün Hatun Hamamı
pins.description: Dating from the Saruhanoğulları Beylik period — pre-Ottoman. Among the largest hammams in Anatolia when built. Original floors preserved. Warm, family-run atmosphere.

pins.name: Cinci Hamamı
pins.description: Inside UNESCO World Heritage Safranbolu. Built by Cinci Hoca in 1645. Perfectly preserved example of a historic Ottoman town hammam. Timber and marble in harmony.

pins.name: Sultan Hamamı
pins.description: In the city of Prophet Abraham, where civilization began. Rich water heritage — Urfa historically had dozens of hammams. Sultan Hamamı carries the city's ancient bathing tradition.

pins.name: Çardaklı Hamamı
pins.description: Built 1520–1540, protected by Ministry of Culture. Black basalt stone construction — the signature material of Diyarbakır. Reflects the spirit of UNESCO-listed city walls.

pins.name: Boyahane Hamamı
pins.description: In one of Türkiye's coldest cities, this hammam has been warming bodies and souls for centuries. Cultural heritage of Erzurum's Ottoman past. Authentic eastern Anatolian ritual.

pins.name: Çarşı Hamamı
pins.description: Featured in poet Nabi's works from the 1600s. Eskişehir's hammams evolved from Byzantine Roman baths. A place where bathing became both art and literature.

pins.name: Kasım Padişah Hamamı
pins.description: In terrace-city Mardin overlooking Mesopotamia. Yellow limestone hammam with Artuqid architectural influences. Ancient bathing ritual at the crossroads of civilizations.

pins.name: Hunad Hatun Hamamı
pins.description: Built in 1238 by Hunad Hatun, wife of Seljuk Sultan Alaeddin Keykubad. One of Türkiye's oldest still-functioning hammams — 800 years of wellness. Pre-Ottoman Seljuk heritage.

pins.name: Sahip Ata Hamamı
pins.description: 13th-century Seljuk hammam in the city of Rumi. Built by grand vizier Sahip Ata Fahreddin Ali. Spiritual bathing in the city where Sufism was born.

pins.name: Meydan Hamamı
pins.description: In Antioch — one of the oldest cities in the world. Roman-Byzantine-Ottoman layers of civilization. Bathing culture in a city that has hosted every great empire.

pins.name: Paşa Hamamı
pins.description: On the ancient Silk Road route. Historic hammam at the heart of Balıkesir's market district. Ottoman bathing tradition serving traders and travelers for centuries.

pins.name: Gediz Hamamı
pins.description: One of the few surviving hammams in İzmir's historic Kemeraltı bazaar. Rare example of Aegean Ottoman hammam culture. Surrounded by spice vendors and artisans.

pins.name: Pamukkale Termal Havuzları
pins.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site. 17 natural hot springs at 35°C. Calcium-rich travertine terraces used for healing since ancient Roman Hierapolis — 2,000+ years of therapeutic bathing.

pins.name: Kleopatra Havuzu (Hierapolis)
pins.description: Legend says Cleopatra bathed in these mineral pools. Swim among sunken Roman columns. 36°C thermal water rich in calcium bicarbonate. The original luxury spa — ancient world edition.

pins.name: Karahayıt Kırmızı Su
pins.description: Iron-rich red mineral water springs — unique color and composition. Used for skin conditions, anemia, and fatigue. Adjacent to Pamukkale, dramatically different mineral profile.

pins.name: Yalova Termal Kaplıcaları
pins.description: Atatürk's favorite retreat — he visited 17 times. One hour from Istanbul by ferry. Lush mountain forest setting. Mineral springs effective for detox, stress, and skin conditions.

pins.name: Çekirge Kaplıcaları
pins.description: Ottoman-era thermal springs in Bursa's most prestigious district. Mineral-rich waters emerging from the slopes of Uludağ. Continuously used since the first Ottoman sultans.

pins.name: İkbal Thermal Hotel & Spa
pins.description: Afyon's thermal waters are among the world's most mineral-rich. Effective for rheumatism, joint pain, skin and metabolic conditions. Medical-grade thermal programs with specialist doctors.

pins.name: Korel Thermal Resort Clinic & Spa
pins.description: Clinical thermal resort combining mineral water therapy with physical rehabilitation. Physician-supervised cure programs. Where medical science meets ancient thermal tradition.

pins.name: NG Afyon Wellness & Convention
pins.description: Winner of Europe's Best Thermal Spa award. Vast wellness complex with multiple thermal pools, mud baths, and comprehensive spa treatments. Premium Afyon thermal experience.

pins.name: Wyndham Afyonkarahisar Thermal & Spa
pins.description: 5-star international brand thermal experience. Aquapark, kids club, thermal pools, full spa. Family-friendly longevity destination combining fun and healing mineral waters.

pins.name: Sandıklı Termal Park
pins.description: Gazlıgöl hot springs near Sandıklı — renowned for CO2-rich mineral water. Effective for cardiovascular health and circulation. Sprawling thermal resort complex.

pins.name: Kızılcahamam Çam Thermal Resort
pins.description: Inside a pine forest national park, 1 hour from Ankara. CO2-rich thermal mineral water. Mud pools, thermal baths, forest air therapy. Urban dwellers' favorite weekend detox.

pins.name: Haymana Termal
pins.description: Rare CO2-rich carbonated mineral springs. Historically recommended for cardiovascular and circulatory health. Medical thermal destination south of Ankara.

pins.name: Pam Thermal Hotel Clinic & Spa
pins.description: 5-star thermal hotel with integrated physical therapy and rehabilitation clinic. Pine forest and garden setting. Hierapolis ruins within driving distance. Full medical thermal program.

pins.name: Doga Thermal Health & Spa
pins.description: 5-star wellness retreat in Pamukkale. On-site rehabilitation clinic, salt room, snow fountain, thermal pools. Where ancient Roman spa culture meets modern medical wellness.

pins.name: Pamukkale Kaya Thermal Hotel
pins.description: 18,000 m² thermal estate with outdoor thermal terraces, indoor pools, and comprehensive spa center. Modern design meets ancient healing waters. Perfect base for Hierapolis exploration.

pins.name: Colossae Thermal Hotel
pins.description: 5-star thermal spa near Karahayıt Red Springs. Horse riding, tennis, mineral pools. Named after ancient Colossae city. Family bathing areas a specialty.

pins.name: İzmir Ilıca Kaplıcaları
pins.description: Çeşme peninsula thermal springs — Aegean's most famous. Seawater and geothermal springs combine. Thalassotherapy meets thermal culture on the Aegean coast.

pins.name: Gönen Kaplıcaları
pins.description: Radioactive thermal waters — rare mineral composition for joint diseases, rheumatism, and skin conditions. One of Türkiye's most medically significant thermal destinations.

pins.name: Termal Kaplıcaları (Türkiye'nin İlk Termal Oteli)
pins.description: Türkiye's first thermal hotel, established in 1930 under Atatürk's vision. Historic thermal park with original Ottoman bathhouses, private cabin baths, and mineral pools.

pins.name: Limak Thermal Hotel
pins.description: Luxury thermal hotel in Yalova's historic termal district. Natural spring-fed pools, forest setting. Exclusive wellness programs combining mineral therapy with modern spa.

pins.name: Kangal Balıklı Kaplıca
pins.description: UNIQUE IN THE WORLD. Doctor fish (Garra rufa) that eat dead skin — natural psoriasis treatment. 37°C thermal water combined with fish therapy. Patients come from 40+ countries.

pins.name: Havza Kaplıcaları
pins.description: Black Sea's most famous thermal center. Sodium bicarbonate mineral water effective for digestive and skin conditions. Ottoman thermal heritage meets Karadeniz wellness culture.

pins.name: Terme Kaplıcaları
pins.description: Natural coastal thermal springs on the Black Sea shore. Rare combination of sea air and geothermal mineral water. The town is literally named after its healing waters.

pins.name: Diyadin Sıcak Su Kaplıcaları
pins.description: Eastern Anatolia's hottest spring — 78°C water. Under the shadow of Mount Ararat. Extreme geothermal activity, dramatic landscape. The hidden gem of Eastern longevity routes.

pins.name: Richmond Nua Wellness Spa
pins.description: 2,700 m² luxury spa on Sapanca Lake shore. 1 hour from Istanbul. Full detox and cleanse programs, thermal facilities, modern architecture in peaceful nature. Executive retreat favorite.

pins.name: The Longevity Suite Istanbul
pins.description: Cutting-edge city longevity clinic in central Istanbul. Cryotherapy chamber at -85°C, HIFU, electromagnetic muscle stimulation. Where biohacking meets the Bosphorus.

pins.name: Dr. Terziler Exclusive Clinic (BIOHAK)
pins.description: Türkiye's only clinic offering full Whole Genome Sequencing (3 billion base pairs) + epigenome methylation profiling + HBOT. DNA-based BIOHAK longevity program. 35 years clinical experience.

pins.name: Marga Wellness Istanbul
pins.description: Clinically driven longevity & biohacking center. Toxin analysis, hormone levels, 3D body avatar tracking, neurological assessment. Data-powered personalized health roadmap.

pins.name: Marga Wellness İzmir
pins.description: Longevity and biohacking in the heart of the Aegean. Same clinically driven protocols as Istanbul — Superhuman performance programs, hormonal optimization, skin health.

pins.name: Istanbul Med Assist
pins.description: NAD+ IV therapy, antioxidant support, regenerative stem cell infusions. International longevity packages 50-70% cheaper than US equivalents. TURSAB registered medical travel agency.

pins.name: TheLifeCo Bodrum
pins.description: Europe's longest-established wellness sanctuary. 20+ years, 30,000+ guests. Kate Moss & Naomi Campbell regulars. Detox, biohacking, raw vegan programs. Aegean coast, clinically precise.

pins.name: TheLifeCo Bodrum Beach
pins.description: Direct beachfront detox retreat. Juice fasting, colon hydrotherapy, infrared sauna, yoga, meditation. Measurable health transformation with Aegean sea as your backdrop.

pins.name: TheLifeCo Antalya (Akra Hotel)
pins.description: Luxury 5-star longevity programs inside Akra Hotel on the Mediterranean coast. Diabetes recovery, weight loss, advanced longevity retreats. Mediterranean panorama + medical precision.

pins.name: Six Senses Kaplankaya
pins.description: 10,000 m² spa — one of the world's largest. Salt grotto, igloo, crystal steam room, Watsu pool, ice fountain. Near two of Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The pinnacle of Aegean wellness.

pins.name: Sianji Well-Being Resort
pins.description: Master Detox program, raw food diets, holistic therapies. Outdoor Bedouin wellness tents overlooking Aegean coastline. Ground-breaking nutritional plans. Complete life reset experience.

pins.name: Mandarin Oriental Bodrum Spa
pins.description: 2,700 m² two-level spa sanctuary. Vitality pool with Aegean views, traditional hammam, hydrotherapy suites, outdoor sauna garden. Biologique Recherche, Aromatherapy Associates treatments.

pins.name: Susona Bodrum LXR Hotels & Resorts
pins.description: Hilton LXR flagship on Aegean coast. Expansive spa with indoor pool, Turkish hammam, hot stone massages, body wraps, custom facials. Luxury wellness from $400/night.

pins.name: Argos in Cappadocia
pins.description: Cave hotel carved into fairy chimneys. Spa with ancient Anatolian therapeutic treatments, Turkish baths, couples massages. Meditation in geological time — surrounded by 3,000-year-old stone.

pins.name: Kayakapi Premium Caves
pins.description: Cappadocia's most luxurious cave wellness experience. Restored 18th-century Greek houses + cave suites. Spa, wine cellar, panoramic views. Healing in the earth's own architecture.

pins.name: Kuum Hotel & Spa Bodrum
pins.description: 2,200 m² wellness center in minimalist modern setting on Türkbükü Bay. 3 restaurants, private beach, world-class treatment menu. Holistic programs combining physical, spiritual, and mental wellness.

pins.name: Memorial Şişli Hospital Longevity Center
pins.description: JCI-accredited hospital with specialized longevity health management. Multidisciplinary approach — oncology, cardiovascular, neurological care for holistic patient longevity.

pins.name: Medipol Mega Üniversite Hastanesi
pins.description: Da Vinci robotic surgery, Gamma Knife technology, organ transplantation. Comprehensive longevity care with 1,000+ beds. International patients from 100+ countries.

pins.name: Acıbadem Longevity & Check-Up
pins.description: Türkiye's largest private hospital group. Executive check-up, anti-aging diagnostics, precision medicine. 20+ hospitals across Türkiye serving 3 million patients annually.

pins.name: Medicana International İstanbul
pins.description: Medicana International İstanbul / Beylikdüzü brings advanced imaging, oncology, multidisciplinary check-up, and international patient services into a major private-hospital campus.

pins.name: Le Méridien Bodrum Beach & Spa
pins.description: Luxury spa and fitness programs with seaside setting. Holistic wellness packages including thalassotherapy, body treatments, and mindfulness programs. Mediterranean longevity lifestyle.

pins.name: Türk Kahvesi Kültürü — Tarihi Kahvehaneler
pins.description: UNESCO Intangible Heritage. Turkish coffee culture born in Istanbul 1554 — the world's first coffeehouses. Rich in antioxidants, polyphenols, chlorogenic acid. A daily longevity ritual for 500 years.

pins.name: Ege Zeytinyağı Rotası — Ayvalık
pins.description: Heart of Türkiye's olive oil production. High-polyphenol extra virgin olive oil linked to longevity and anti-inflammatory diets. Blue Zone diet cornerstone. 1,000-year-old olive trees still producing.

pins.name: Datça Nar & Badem Bahçeleri
pins.description: Datça peninsula — pomegranate and almond capital. Pomegranate = longevity superfood, rich in punicalagins. Isolated peninsula preserves ancient Mediterranean diet traditions.

pins.name: Kula Siyah İnciri
pins.description: World's highest quality black fig variety. Potent antioxidants, calcium, potassium. Grown in volcanic Kula soil for centuries. Ancient longevity food of the Aegean.

pins.name: Gaziantep Antep Fıstığı Bahçeleri
pins.description: Türkiye produces 60% of the world's pistachios. Antep fıstığı = brain health, omega fatty acids, vitamin E. Centuries-old pistachio orchards around Gaziantep. UNESCO Creative City of Gastronomy.

pins.name: Karadeniz Hamsi Kültürü
pins.description: Black Sea anchovy — the omega-3 richest small fish in the world. 600+ hamsi recipes. Brain health, cardiovascular longevity, anti-inflammatory. A cultural identity built around longevity food.

pins.name: Ege Otları & Zeytinyağlılar Kültürü
pins.description: Aegean herb and wild greens culture — purslane, fennel, wild chicory, samphire. Eaten with olive oil for centuries. The foundation of the Mediterranean longevity diet. İzmir's local markets are a longevity pharmacy.

pins.name: Trakya Bağ Kültürü — Kalecik Karası
pins.description: Thrace wine culture — home of Turkey's finest indigenous grape varieties. Resveratrol-rich Kalecik Karası and Öküzgözü. Ancient Thracian viticulture tradition meeting longevity science.

pins.name: Kapadokya Bağları & Yerel Üzüm
pins.description: Ancient Cappadocian vineyards — volcanic soil, unique terroir. Indigenous Emir and Dimrit varieties. Winemaking tradition going back 5,000 years in fairy chimney landscapes.

pins.name: Kazdağı Organik Köyleri & Yaban Otları
pins.description: Mount Ida — mythological home of Zeus. Pristine organic mountain herbs: sage, thyme, oregano, wild rosemary. Polyphenol-rich olive groves. A living longevity pantry.

pins.name: Kazdağı Yoga & Doğa Kampı
pins.description: Mount Ida natural park — negative ions, phytoncides, crystal-clear streams. Yoga, breathwork, forest bathing (shinrin-yoku). Mythological mountain where gods chose the fairest. Now choosing wellness.

pins.name: Ölüdeniz Mavi Lagün
pins.description: One of the world's most beautiful and cleanest lagoons. Sea, pine forest, and mountain in perfect harmony. Paragliding from Babadağ, swimming meditation, breathwork on the shore.

pins.name: Göcek Mavi Yolculuk & Retreat
pins.description: Gulet boat wellness retreats through secluded Aegean bays. Yoga at sunrise, swimming in turquoise coves, organic meals, digital detox on water. The original blue zone cruise.

pins.name: Kapadokya Balon Deneyimi — Mindfulness
pins.description: Sunrise hot air balloon over fairy chimneys — a transformative mindfulness experience. Floating in silence above 3,000-year-old geological formations. Ultimate perspective reset.

pins.name: Abant Gölü Doğa Retreatı
pins.description: Pristine highland lake inside national park. Rich oxygen environment, forest walks, natural serenity. 2.5 hours from Istanbul — the city's breathing space. Natural stress therapy.

pins.name: Uzungöl Doğa & Yürüyüş
pins.description: Black Sea's most serene highland lake surrounded by misty mountains. Forest bathing, highland tea culture, complete digital detox. Nature therapy in Karadeniz's most iconic landscape.

pins.name: Ilgaz Dağı Orman Kampı
pins.description: Dense fir and pine forest at high altitude. Shinrin-yoku (forest bathing) at its purest. Natural phytoncide therapy, birdwatching, stargazing. North Anatolian wilderness retreat.

pins.name: Saklıkent Kanyonu — Soğuk Su Terapisi
pins.description: Europe's deepest canyon after Alpine ones. Ice-cold glacial meltwater rushing through 18km gorge. Natural cold water immersion therapy. Ancient Lycian route meets modern wellness science.

pins.name: Ağva Orman & Nehir Retreatı
pins.description: Where two rivers meet the Black Sea, 1 hour from Istanbul. Forest, river kayaking, silence, organic farm food. The Istanbulite's escape valve — nature therapy at the city's edge.

pins.name: Bozburun Koyu — İzole Koy Retreatı
pins.description: Secluded Aegean cove accessible only by boat. Complete silence, turquoise water, wild thyme hillsides. The ultimate digital detox — no road, no noise, only nature and sea.

pins.name: Kangal Balıklı Kaplıca — Doğal Terapi
pins.description: World's only natural fish therapy spa. Garra rufa doctor fish eat dead skin cells in 37°C thermal water. Clinically proven for psoriasis. Patients travel from 40+ countries. Truly unique to Türkiye.

pins.name: Divriği Ulu Cami Şifahanesi
pins.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site. Built 1228 by Mengücek ruler. Türkiye's oldest surviving hospital (şifahane). Architecture considered a miracle — intricate stone carvings unmatched anywhere. Healing has been practiced here for 800 years.

pins.name: Bergama Asklepionu (Pergamon)
pins.description: 4th century BC healing temple of Asclepius — ancient god of medicine. Dream therapy, mud baths, herbal remedies, music therapy. Galen, history's greatest physician after Hippocrates, trained here. The original longevity center.

pins.name: Efes Antik Şifahanesi
pins.description: Roman-era medical complex in Ephesus — once home to 250,000 people. Ancient pharmacy, surgical theater, thermal baths. UNESCO World Heritage. Healing city of the ancient world.

pins.name: Edirne Kanuni Külliyesi Şifahanesi
pins.description: Built 1488 by Bayezid II. World's first hospital to use music therapy for mental health treatment. Musicians played three times a week for psychiatric patients. Ottoman medicine was 500 years ahead of its time.

pins.name: Medicana International Samsun
pins.description: Black Sea regional private-hospital campus with broad specialist units, international patient services, check-up, oncology, cardiology, and preventive care pathways.

pins.name: Medicana Konya
pins.description: Comprehensive Central Anatolia hospital with intensive care, check-up, cardiology, oncology, dietetics, and multidisciplinary diagnostic services for preventive health planning.

pins.name: Medicana Sivas
pins.description: Modern Sivas hospital serving Central Anatolia with 24/7 emergency, oncology, dialysis, intensive care, diagnostics, and preventive check-up services.

pins.name: Medicana Bursa
pins.description: Bursa hospital with advanced diagnostics, oncology, cardiology, genetic medicine, sleep lab, intensive care, and broad preventive health services.

pins.name: Medicana International İzmir
pins.description: Aegean international hospital with robotic surgery, check-up, oncology, cardiology, advanced imaging, and multidisciplinary preventive-care capacity.

pins.name: Medicana Çeşme
pins.description: Çeşme medical center extending the Medicana Aegean health ecosystem with tourism-focused outpatient care, diagnostics, emergency support, and wellness-oriented services.

pins.name: Medicana Avcılar
pins.description: Long-established Avcılar hospital with check-up, dialysis, intensive care, medical aesthetics, full-body MRI, and multidisciplinary health services.

pins.name: Medicana Çamlıca
pins.description: Üsküdar / Çamlıca hospital with health-tourism authorization, cardiology, nephrology, GETAT, IVF, oncology, and multidisciplinary specialist units.

pins.name: Medicana Bahçelievler
pins.description: Central European-side hospital with dialysis, cardiology, cardiovascular surgery, gastroenterology, physical therapy, intensive care, and multidisciplinary diagnostics.

pins.name: Medicana Kadıköy
pins.description: Anatolian-side hospital serving Kadıköy and international patients with modern medical technology, specialist physicians, check-up, and multidisciplinary care.

pins.name: Medicana Ataşehir
pins.description: High-technology Ataşehir hospital with check-up, organ transplant, oncology, cardiology, robotic and specialty surgical services, and international patient capacity.

pins.name: Medicana Ataköy
pins.description: New Ataköy hospital designed as a major European-side health campus with international patient services, advanced diagnostics, oncology, organ transplant, and robotic rehabilitation.
